name: Nuxa (now Semperi)
oneLiner: Semperi, sold by Nuxa, Inc. (the team behind Fleksa), is an AI marketing team for local businesses: it builds the website, writes social posts, drafts Google review replies, takes orders and bookings, sends email and texts, and reports weekly. nuxa.ai now redirects to semperi.com.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and other single-location local businesses that want review replies handled together with their website, posts and online orders, with the owner approving everything.

updates.text: nuxa.ai now redirects to semperi.com. The product is sold as Semperi, made by the team behind Fleksa, for 38 kinds of local business; the footer reads Nuxa, Inc. The date of the change isn't published.

features: Drafts a reply in the owner's voice to every new Google review; low ratings come to the owner first, and nothing posts without approval
Checks the Google Business Profile for new reviews every day (Google reviews only)
Reply tone can be changed in chat ('shorter', 'warmer') and is kept for next time
Builds a website from the existing site, Google profile and menu, with online ordering and table bookings
Instagram and Facebook posts made from your real photos and prices, approved before they go out
DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub orders land in the same list through KitchenHub
Email and text campaigns to bring guests back on slow days
Weekly report on orders, sales, reviews, posts and bookings, with one next step
Integrations: Google Business Profile, Search Console, Analytics, Gmail, Calendar, Stripe; Facebook, Instagram and TikTok posting through Zernio

pricing.text: Free scan, then $1 a month for the first 3 months on any plan; after that Site $99, Starter $299 or Growth $499 a month per location (USD).

notes: 2026-11 rewrite: nuxa.ai (and every nuxa.ai path, including /solutions/voice and /pricing) returns 301 to semperi.com. Semperi's footer reads '© 2026 Nuxa, Inc.'; its About page says it's made by the team behind Fleksa and that 4,200+ restaurants run on the platform behind Semperi (vendor figure). The named agents (Grace, Scout, Dash), AI phone answering, the $49 voice plan and the Toast/Square/Clover integrations from the earlier sheet no longer appear on the site and were dropped. Review replies are drafts for approval only (the earlier auto-reply for positive reviews isn't offered now). Plan contents aren't listed. Website kept as nuxa.ai because the live post links it and it redirects to semperi.com; consider switching to https://www.semperi.com/. No G2 listing found.
pros: Every reply waits for the owner's approval, and low ratings reach the owner first
Review replies sit with the website, posts, orders and weekly report in one service
Published per-location prices, with $1 a month for the first 3 months
Made by the team behind Fleksa; 4,200+ restaurants run on the platform behind Semperi (vendor figure)

cons.text: No automatic posting: every reply waits for the owner's approval, so replies go out only as fast as someone approves them
The pricing page doesn't say which plan includes review replies
Built for single local businesses across 38 categories and priced per location, so a restaurant group may need another tool for reporting across sites
Renamed from Nuxa to Semperi, with no named customers or dated product news

plans.trial: Free scan, then $1 a month for the first 3 months
